title: Authentication, Participant Binding, Membership Verification and Operator Authority
claims: Authentication-provider identity is not canonical Participant identity.
Identity binding requires an AuthorityEvaluator-approved identity.bind grant.
Membership establishment requires an AuthorityEvaluator-approved membership.verify grant and qualifying eligibility evidence.
Revoked authority and inactive membership fail closed.
A bound identity cannot be silently rebound to a different Participant.
